segments.name: community banking
products: comprehensive wealth management and trust services
segments.description: Community banking segment holding the company's commercial and retail loan and deposit activities and related services for consumers and businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: community banking.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers and depositors pay interest and fees on commercial and retail loans, deposits, cash management, private banking and wealth management services.
revenueModel.evidence: The segment primarily encompasses the commercial loan and deposit activities of the Company as well as retail lending and deposit activities in areas surrounding the branches.

changes.text: In 2025 HomeStreet Bank merged with and into Mechanics Bank, and its assets, liabilities and operations became those of Mechanics Bank.
changes.evidence: Following the strategic Merger of HomeStreet Bank with and into Mechanics Bank on September 2, 2025, with Mechanics Bank surviving the Merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, the assets, liabilities and operations of HomeStreet Bank became the assets, liabilities and operations of Mechanics Bank.

changes.text: Mechanics Bank ceased originating auto loans in 2023 and moved servicing of its remaining portfolio to a third-party servicer in 2025.
changes.evidence: Ceasing the origination of auto loans in February 2023, Mechanics Bank continued to service its existing auto loan portfolio until May 1, 2025, when it entered into a servicing agreement with a third-party servicer to oversee and manage Mechanics Bank's active portfolio of auto loans.
